  "subject": "C17",
  "fingerprints": {
    "source": "8ea9ebae796cc73997c7ec2e1dc960edf9c349bf200defbf1bd146f4f759856d",
    "dependencies": "d3ce73b7804b64f7ae7f59507afb068c491dba6362ef9eaf5f7aebff28bf08da",

    "evidence": "637b6ee90dd586f48c0c204d7492f7a4921d67d98e9cba5b4f26987e6a1efae2"
  },
  "scores": {
    "architecture": 9,
    "behavior": 7,
    "authority_security": 8,
    "validation": 7,
    "overall": 7
  },
  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 — Retire scoped Apply work when its WorkspaceRef retires. authority/change_domain.rs:595-598 admits ApplyJob under the tenant's cx- domain, while authority/gateway_domain.rs:124-132,189-200 retires only gw- operations on a workspace change. sync_changes removes the pending review but retains applying records by tenant context; apply_gateway:1523-1545 subsequently checks the captured baseline, not whether the selection is still current. Consequently, after confirming an A-scoped change, switching to B while the job is queued or awaiting its baseline does not prevent a later write to A. The existing workspace test switches before confirmation completes and misses this interval. Acceptance: through Core's production interface, hold an Apply before dispatch, switch A→B and A→B→A, then release it; no write may be sent, the old reference must stay retired, and queued/in-flight retirement must preserve not-sent versus uncertain outcomes. Preserve tenant/credential retirement as well.",
    "R2 — Check the all-models setting during model readback. gateway_changes.rs:1371-1397 verifies only requested model slug/enabled pairs. The accepted GatewayIntegrationModelsBulkUpdateRequest also supports allow_all_models, but readback never compares it with read.allow_all. For a valid draft such as {\"models\":[{\"slug\":\"gpt-4o\",\"enabled\":true}],\"allow_all_models\":false}, matching model rows cause Found even when the service still reports all models allowed, and the UI reports the change applied/read back. Acceptance: literal fixtures must cover both values of allow_all_models and an ignored flag with otherwise matching model rows; a mismatching flag must produce differs, while matching requested settings pass.",
    "R3 — Make provisioning summaries reflect reconciliation and cleanup facts. runtime-changes.tsx:488-495 calls provisioning verified solely from completed write steps, ignoring scopeRead, workspaceRead and boundRead. An in-memory execution of this source function returned 'The workspace and its IAM scope binding were read back' both when reconciliation failed and when boundRead was false. Also, gateway_changes.rs:419-426 says nothing is undone automatically although the SDK cleanup path, exercised by the supplied refused-workspace test, deletes a newly created scope; an uncertain cleanup cannot truthfully be summarized as 'Nothing was undone.' Acceptance: App/DesktopClient tests must distinguish successful writes from failed/absent/incomplete/unbound reconciliation and successful/uncertain scope cleanup. Only established readback may be described as verified, and review/result wording must match the actual cleanup policy.",
    "R4 — Reconcile the workspace created by this attempt, rather than the first workspace sharing its IAM scope. gateway_changes.rs:1291-1297 selects by scope_name alone and overwrites even a workspace_id/slug already obtained from the SDK. Reusing an IAM scope already used by workspace A to provision C therefore permits A to replace C in the report; bound_read at :1316-1317 then checks A's binding. A failed C binding can consequently appear bound because A was already bound. The existing reuse test checks only the scope state and absence of a scope POST. Acceptance: with A listed first and sharing the reused scope, preserve C's known identity and reconcile C's binding; cover failed binding and lost create replies too. When the new workspace cannot be identified unambiguously, report that uncertainty instead of attributing A to the attempt.",
    "R5 — Preserve received write results when only readback is cancelled. authority/change_domain.rs:1415-1444 drops the apply future on cancellation and uses only a sent boolean, returning Unknown after any dispatch. In apply_gateway:1577-1616, a successful write reply and its extracted one-time key remain local while readback awaits. Stopping during that readback discards both the established completion and the key, even though the write's success is already known. Acceptance: let a key create/rotate succeed, hold its subsequent GET, then CancelChange; retain Completed as the write outcome, report the interrupted readback separately, and retain the key for its authorized single native reveal. Keep NotSent before dispatch and Unknown for an unanswered write; test the shared Runtime/DLP cancellation path affected by this change.",
    "R6 — Implement C17's required offline local-work and recovery behavior. GatewayView stores the change only in React state (:193), ChangeWorkbench keeps editor text only in the mounted textarea, and the persisted state has no Gateway drafts or recovery records. The restart test at gateway_changes/main.rs:1573-1594 explicitly expects all results to disappear; it does not exercise an offline restart after an uncertain provisioning. Thus an application restart loses the editable configuration draft and the uncertain step/outcome information needed for explicit reconciliation. D043's memory-only-results statement does not satisfy chunks/C17.md:41 or T23's offline launch/read/edit and preserved uncertain outcomes. Acceptance: retain protected, tenant/workspace-labelled draft and recovery data across offline restart, allow local read/edit with truthful stale/unknown state, and demonstrate reconnection sends no write automatically. Restored data must carry no valid review/Apply authority, credential or one-time key; retry requires a fresh explicit review."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "G1 — The advertised D043 write matrix is not qualified operation by operation. The supplied gateway_changes suite exercises provider update/delete, route update, guardrail create, service-key create/rotate, workspace provision/archive and integration models, but supplies no successful production-interface wire case for workspace update, provider create, route create/delete, guardrail update/delete, service-key update/delete, any user-key write, or integration create/update/delete. A generic fixture handler and SDK typechecking do not verify these application's normalized requests, scope, options, responses and readbacks. Supply literal independent request/response assertions and the required settlement mapping for every advertised operation, including its relevant rejection/unknown cases, bound to the revised source; alternatively an actual authorized scope reduction must precede any removed claim."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "All supplied fingerprints recompute exactly. Verified 553 source-inventory entries, 292 referenced hashes, run log/artifact hashes, and the 21-record predecessor chain. C16's failed 9/8/9/8/8 review was explicitly owner-accepted under D034 in completions.jsonl; that is distinct from a passing review.",
    "C16 R1 and R2 are remediated in the inspected source: item-keyed model panels with stale-reply guards and an accessible Workspace detail tab. The supplied App/DesktopClient regressions cover cached and pending A-to-B model transitions and workspace details/failures; native evidence covers the Workspace view. This review does not alter C16's historical receipt or replace its required P05 re-review.",
    "Recorded checks pass: 360 desktop tests, 162 core library tests, 12 Gateway change integration tests, and the scoped Runtime/DLP/Gateway-read/IPC regressions. The 35 recorded mutation probes match current source hashes and report named guard failures; four baseline targets passed three times each. These results do not close the findings or G1.",
    "The ten C17 native checks and C01-C16 regression records report pass against fixture executable c3e348c0634d060096b2626243818bc201a9a6920357d037d02e36f9d04eb6c6. Inspected the C17 driver, observations and Accessibility trees. Native acceptance was not independently rerun; spoken VoiceOver is not recorded.",
    "Independently executed provisioningText from the inspected TypeScript source entirely in memory for failed reconciliation and a false binding. Both produced the incorrect verified-readback message. The other causal defects were established by source and test inspection; no new endpoint-based reproduction or product test run was performed.",
    "Gateway endpoints and faults are synthetic; live qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification C26. D043's deferred credential entry, protected routing merge, integration bindings, policy APIs and MCP are not qualified here. No application source was changed, product endpoint called or credential accessed; only the designated verdict artifact was written."
  ],
